A1 [Y]: Named release/family is linked to an official dataset/download or evidence page; no file retrieval is implied.

A2 [Y]: A documented download or request route is stated. Account/terms requirements do not lower documentation credit.

A3 [Y]: Dataset-specific terms are explicitly summarized; upstream component rights and intended-use compatibility remain separate.

L1 [Y]: Available target meanings are described for the dataset task. General AV targets are not represented as pavement-condition labels.

L2 [U]: Label encoding and assignment/measurement procedure are not both established.

L4 [U]: Concrete label-review/verification/correction practice is not established by the saved summary.

D1 [Y]: Formats and the relationship between input files and target/time/record identifiers are described.

D2 [Y]: Publisher/collector or compiler and a useful collection/generation method or parent source are described.

D4 [Y]: The source summary records an explicit released-scope boundary, exclusion or intended-use limitation. Reviewer recommendations do not themselves earn credit.

C1 [Y]: Reported count and unit are identified; streams, frames, images and annotations are not assumed independent.

C2 [Y]: The summary provides relevant class/subset or target-availability counts/proportions, rather than only a grand total.

R1 [U]: Actual collection geography/site and capture context are not jointly established; affiliation is not geography.

R2 [Y]: Meaningful variation or an explicitly bounded collection context is described; a broad domain does not inherently earn more points.

M1 [Y]: Camera/sensor, capture platform or synthetic/data-generation method is documented.

M2 [U]: Required pixel geometry or sensor sampling/measurement units are not stated for this target representation.

M5 [Y]: A concrete transformation/patch extraction/projection/reconstruction or data-generation process is described.

sourceV3.Match_Evidence: Same Mendeley deposit (10.17632/kfth5g2xk3); both describe a semantic-segmentation pothole/crack compilation from five source datasets.
sourceV3.Number_of_Images: 4340 image-mask pairs; plus 797 RGB clips and 797 disparity clips, of which 359 have binary mask clips
sourceV3.Number_of_Samples: 4340 image-mask pairs; plus 797 RGB clips and 797 disparity clips, of which 359 have binary mask clips
sourceV3.Country: NR (aggregated from five previously published datasets) [Claude] | Multi-source [GPT]
sourceV3.Geographic_Coverage: NR (aggregated from five previously published datasets) [Claude] | Multi-source [GPT]; Road environment: Urban road; Rural road [Claude] | Road surface [GPT]
sourceV3.Acquisition_Platform: Mixed (inherited from five source datasets) plus OAK-D stereo depth cameras for the video subset [Claude] | Composite from five public datasets plus small author addition [GPT]
sourceV3.Camera_Type: Mixed (inherited from five source datasets) plus OAK-D stereo depth cameras for the video subset [Claude] | Composite from five public datasets plus small author addition [GPT]
sourceV3.Label_Taxonomy: Binary and multi-class segmentation masks for potholes and cracks [Claude] | Pothole and crack segmentation masks [GPT]
sourceV3.Annotation_Format: Image-mask pairs; RGB-D video clips with disparity maps
sourceV3.Annotation_Source: Manual annotation inherited from source datasets; semi-automatic mask generation from post-processed disparity maps for the video subset [Claude] | Assembled from five datasets; small added segmentation set [GPT]
sourceV3.Annotation_Quality_Control: Authors state explicitly that the disparity-derived video masks are imperfect and are offered as a starting point rather than ground truth
sourceV3.AI_Task_Evidence: Reported on the source record/data card or associated publication (see Evidence_Locator)
sourceV3.Key_Limitations: Aggregated from five upstream datasets, so provenance and licence compatibility must be checked per component before redistribution; countries, resolutions and collection dates are not enumerated; video-subset masks are semi-automatic and acknowledged as imperfect; CC BY-NC 3.0 blocks commercial reuse [Claude] | Composite derivative with unresolved source overlap, licensing compatibility, file counts, and provenance; unsuitable for primary ranking without file-level audit [GPT]
